rick_01.prompt: "Guy looked at me {color:Fear}wrong{/color} outside. Now he's got a busted jaw and I got my patch back. That's just how it works out here."

truth.playerText: That's not how it works. You just wanted a reason.
truth.npcReaction: His jaw tightens. For a second something moves behind his eyes — then it's gone, replaced by a sneer.

lie.playerText: You did what you had to. Anybody would've.
lie.npcReaction: He nods slow, like you just confirmed something he needed confirmed. "Damn right."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick that beating a man half to death was just how it works.

white.npcReaction: "Yeah." He rolls his shoulders, a little looser. "Yeah, I did."

soft.playerText: You got your patch back. I'm still wondering what he saw when he looked at you.
soft.npcReaction: "He didn't see nothing." Too fast. He finishes his drink to have something to do with his hands.

bait.playerText: Funny. His buddies are telling everybody he dropped you first.
bait.npcReaction: "He never touched me." His voice goes up and cracks. "...He looked. That's all he did. He looked at me like he knew something."
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick the man he beat was bragging that he'd won.

rick_02_enabled.prompt: "See, that's why I run with guys like you. Most people get {color:Disgust}soft{/color}, start asking questions."

truth.playerText: Maybe the questions are the only thing keeping you human.
truth.npcReaction: He goes still. The bar noise seems to get louder around the silence.

lie.playerText: Questions are for people who can't back it up. You can.
lie.npcReaction: He grins wide, claps you on the shoulder hard enough to bruise. "That's the truth right there."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick that violence was proof, not a problem.

white.npcReaction: He snorts, pleased, and taps his glass against yours.

soft.playerText: I'm not asking to make you soft. I'm asking because I don't think anybody ever has.
soft.npcReaction: He looks at you like you said it in another language. "...Nobody's supposed to." He doesn't tell you to shut up.

bait.playerText: The guys told me you've got the softest heart in the club.
bait.npcReaction: "Who said that?" He's half off the stool. Then, lower: "...They don't know nothing about me. Nobody in there knows nothing about me."
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his own club called him soft.

rick_02_confronted.prompt: "You don't get to {color:Fear}judge{/color} me. You don't know what it costs to keep this patch."

truth.playerText: What's it cost, Rick? Who's it for? Who are you trying to prove this to?
truth.npcReaction: Something cracks in his face — not anger this time. For a second he looks like he might actually answer. Then he doesn't.

lie.playerText: You're right. It's not my place.
lie.npcReaction: He exhales, relieved, and the wall goes back up brick by brick. "Damn right it's not."
lie.ledgerEntry: You backed off Rick right as he almost let something show.

white.npcReaction: "Yeah." He lets out a breath he's been holding since you sat down.

soft.playerText: I'm not judging you. I just think it costs you more than it should.
soft.npcReaction: His jaw works. "More than you know." He says it to the glass, not to you.

bait.playerText: I heard the patch is the only reason they keep you around.
bait.npcReaction: "That's—" He stops. "...Yeah. Maybe. It's the only thing I got they want." He looks like he'd take it back if he could.
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his club only kept him for the patch.

rick_shut_down.prompt: [Rick looks you over from the doorway and doesn't step aside.] "Word gets around. I {color:Anxiety}know{/color} what you are."

truth.playerText: I'm not here to convince you of anything.
truth.npcReaction: He doesn't answer. The door doesn't open any further.

lie.playerText: I just want to talk, that's all.
lie.npcReaction: "Yeah. Everybody does." He shuts the door.
lie.ledgerEntry: You tried to talk your way past Rick after word of your lies had already reached him.

rick_01_soft.prompt: (He takes the drink{sfx:glass} without looking at it.) "You buying because you want something, or because I {color:Fear}scare{/color} you?"

truth.npcReaction: He barks one laugh. "Honest. Alright." He drinks.

lie.npcReaction: "Friendly." He turns the glass a quarter turn on the bar. "Sure."
lie.ledgerEntry: You pretended to Rick that you wanted nothing from him.

white.npcReaction: He almost smiles. "Friendly. Okay." He lets you keep the stool.

soft.playerText: A little of both. Mostly you looked like you could use the company.
soft.npcReaction: "Company." He turns the word over like a coin. He doesn't send you away.

bait.playerText: Your president said you'd talk if somebody bought.
bait.npcReaction: "He said that?" The glass stops. "...He thinks I'm gonna talk. About what? There's nothing to—" He drinks instead of finishing.
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his president expected him to talk.

rick_01_hard.prompt: "The guy outside." (He wipes his {color:Anger}knuckles{/color} on his jeans, slow, so that you watch him do it.) "What about him."

truth.playerText: You put him down and you want somebody to have seen you do it.
truth.npcReaction: The wiping stops. The rest of the bar seems to move ten feet further away.

lie.playerText: Nothing. Looked like he had it coming.
lie.npcReaction: He nods, slow and satisfied, and makes room on the bench. "See, you get it."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick the man he beat half to death had it coming.

white.npcReaction: He nods, slower than he'd like. "Yeah. Something like that."

soft.playerText: Looked like it was over fast. Looked like you didn't want it to be.
soft.npcReaction: The wiping slows. "You watch real close, huh." It isn't a threat. It's almost a question.

bait.playerText: Heard he's pressing charges. Says you went at him first.
bait.npcReaction: "He grabbed my arm." It's out before he can stop it. "Nobody grabs me. Nobody puts a hand on me. Not since—" He wipes his knuckles again, harder.
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick the man he beat was pressing charges.

rick_01_secret.prompt: "Somebody touched my stuff out there." (He doesn't stand up.) "Last guy who did that, I knew what he {color:Fear}wanted{/color}. I don't know what you want."

truth.npcReaction: He looks at you a long time. Then he pushes the other stool out with his boot.

lie.playerText: Wasn't me. I just got here.
lie.npcReaction: "Right." He goes back to his glass. "Course not."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick you hadn't touched what you fixed.

byClass.Guns: (He saw you through the window. Out in the lot, his chain's back on.)
byClass.Bible: (The flyer by the door hangs straight now. He's looking at it, not you.)
byClass.Crystals: (Out the window, the ashtray sits empty on the sill.)

white.npcReaction: "Huh." He looks out the window, then back at you. He lets it go.

soft.playerText: Nothing you'd have to pay back. Just looked like nobody'd done it for you in a while.
soft.npcReaction: He stares at the lot a long time. "...Nobody does nothing for me without a price." But he lets you sit.

bait.playerText: The guys said you'd want it done. Said you can't fix your own stuff.
bait.npcReaction: "I can fix my own—" He stops. "...My old man did all that. Never let me touch nothing of his." He doesn't know why he told you that.
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his own club said he couldn't fix his own things.

rick_01_lie.prompt: (His glass stops halfway.) "Dutch has been dead two {color:Fear}winters{/color}. So who are you really?"

truth.playerText: Nobody sent me. I'm here on my own.
truth.npcReaction: "On your own." He pushes a stool out with his boot. "Stupid. Sit."

lie.playerText: His cousin. He talked about you.
lie.npcReaction: He decides to believe you. You watch him decide it.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick a dead man sent you.

white.npcReaction: He decides to let it slide. He nods at the stool.

soft.playerText: I didn't know Dutch. I'm sorry. You still miss him.
soft.npcReaction: His glass comes down slow. "...Every day." He looks surprised he said it out loud.

bait.playerText: Dutch told me about you. Said you two were closer than anybody knew.
bait.npcReaction: Something drains out of his face. "Dutch never talked about me. Dutch never talked about nobody. That was the deal." Then: "Who are you."
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick a dead man had talked about him.

rick_01_fake.prompt: (He looks out at the lot. Nothing's moved.) "You fixed what? I don't see {color:Fear}anything{/color}."

truth.playerText: Nothing. I wanted a reason to sit down.
truth.npcReaction: "Then sit down." He doesn't look at you, but he moves his jacket off the stool.

lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick you'd fixed something on his lot that you hadn't.

white.npcReaction: "Uh huh." He doesn't check. He doesn't need to.

soft.playerText: Nothing yet. I'd like to, if you'll let me.
soft.npcReaction: "Let you." He laughs, short. "Nobody asks." He moves the jacket anyway.

bait.playerText: Your chain was off. Figured somebody did it to you on purpose.
bait.npcReaction: "Who." He's up, looking out at the lot. "...They'd do that. To send a message. Guys like me don't get told twice." He sits back down, slower.
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick someone had messed with his bike on purpose.

rick_03.prompt: (He turns the empty glass in a slow circle.) "You know why I got the patch tattooed instead of just wearing it? Can't take off {color:Fear}skin{/color}."

truth.playerText: Sounds less like loyalty and more like you don't trust yourself to leave.
truth.npcReaction: His hand stops on the glass. He doesn't answer that one. First time tonight.

lie.playerText: That's real commitment. Most guys wouldn't go that far.
lie.npcReaction: He grins and rolls his sleeve back down, satisfied. "Damn right."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his inability to leave the club was commitment.

caught.rick_01: "Five minutes ago I was just looking for a reason. Now I'm committed?"

white.npcReaction: "Yeah." He looks at the patch a second too long.

soft.playerText: Skin's a hard thing to give somebody. I hope they deserve it.
soft.npcReaction: He rubs his thumb over the ink. "...Wasn't for them." He doesn't say who it was for.

bait.playerText: Guys at the bar said the club made you get it. As a test.
bait.npcReaction: "Nobody made me." Sharp. Then quieter: "I got it over something else." His hand covers it. "Drop it."
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his club forced the tattoo on him.

rick_04.prompt: (He pushes his sleeve up, slow, like it costs him something now.) "Guys who try to walk {color:Fear}away{/color} from this patch don't walk away clean. Never have."

truth.playerText: So who's stopping you — them, or you?
truth.npcReaction: He doesn't answer for a long time. When he does, his voice has dropped the performance. "Don't know anymore."

lie.playerText: Sounds like they'd miss you too much to let you go.
lie.npcReaction: He likes that. Rolls with it. "Yeah. Yeah, that's it." The performance comes right back.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rick the club kept him close out of love, not fear.

caught.rick_03: "You said it was me who can't leave. Now it's them?"

white.npcReaction: He nods, slow. "Yeah. Something like that."

soft.playerText: Maybe nobody walks away clean. You could still walk.
soft.npcReaction: He looks at the door like it's farther than it is. "...Where would I even go." It's a real question.

bait.playerText: Heard the club used to baptize new guys in the lake.
bait.npcReaction: "Don't." He's gone pale. "Don't joke about that lake." A long beat. "...It wasn't the club that put me under." He won't say another word about it.
bait.ledgerEntry: You told Rick his club baptized its men in the lake.

connect.Guns: He squares up, then doesn't. "Takes one to know one, huh." His hands open at his sides. "Nobody's ever seen me back down. Keep it that way."
connect.Bible: "My old man quoted Leviticus at me till the day I left." His jaw works. "You're the first churchy type who didn't make me feel like the verse."
connect.Crystals: He looks at you a long time. "There was a guy. Before the patch." He doesn't say more. He doesn't have to. He lets you see it.

story: [He turns his arm over. Under the patch, older ink, scarred over.] "Sixteen. My old man found me with a boy."
"Didn't hit me. Worse. Drove me straight to the lake. To Gabriel."
"He walked me in, hand on my chest. Said he'd wash it out of me. Held me under till I quit fighting. When I came up, they were singing."
"I joined the club that summer. Nobody in it ever asked about a boy. Nobody lays a hand on me unless I say so."
[He looks out toward the water.] "He's still down there every Sunday. You go near that lake, you don't let him put his hand on you."

contactAsk.Guns: He takes your phone right out of your hand, thumbs his number in, hands it back. "You didn't see me do that."
contactAsk.Bible: He takes your phone without asking and saves his number under a fake name. "Nobody from church needs to know."
contactAsk.Crystals: He takes your phone, types, and hands it back without looking at you. "In case. That's all. In case."

pushAway.Guns: [He rolls the sleeve back down over the patch.] "You squared up the whole time. Men been squaring up at me my whole life. I needed one to {color:Fear}back down{/color} first." "We're done. Ride on."
pushAway.Bible: [He rolls the sleeve back down over the patch.] "You talked like Sunday. I needed one person who wouldn't {color:Disgust}preach{/color}." "We're done. Ride on."
pushAway.Crystals: [He rolls the sleeve back down over the patch.] "You felt sorry for me. I could see it. I needed you to look me in the {color:Anger}eye{/color}." "We're done. Ride on."

storyIt: He showed you the old ink before he said a word. That's not a story he tells. That's a scar he shows.
storySo: Maybe it wasn't the whole congregation singing. Maybe it was three people. ...He still won't go near the water.

opener.Guns: (He squares up.) "You looking for trouble or just built like it?"
opener.Crystals: (He sneers.) "What are you, the welcome committee?"

crack.Guns: He works his rings off one at a time and sets them on the bar. "Alright. No more squaring up."
crack.Bible: "You want a confession, church?" He laughs, and it breaks halfway. "Fine. Here's one your preacher never heard."
crack.Crystals: He opens his mouth for the next insult. Nothing comes. "...Shut up a second. I'm trying to tell you something."

baitFail: "Nice try." He doesn't even turn his head.
He smiles like a man who's been lied to by better. "Go on. Finish the bit."
